context: Sho-young goes camping for the first time with Daichi.
purpose: Father introducing son to outdoor camp experience.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、テント張れた!
lines.en: Dad — we got the tent up!
lines.style: Quick proud breath. Bright voice, almost singing the achievement. Reaching upward at the end, wanting to share this with him. No hesitation — pure accomplishment.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Warm, generous laugh underneath. Kansai warmth — soft and approving. Lands firmly on the praise but doesn't overstate it. A father's quiet pride.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 焚き火、ぱちぱちしてる。
lines.style: Hushed with wonder. Soft, observant. Noticing the small sensory detail — the sound pulling his attention. Wonder-struck, not excited, but deeply present in the moment.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: The stars'll be out all night — so many of them.
lines.style: Gentle Kansai cadence. Slow, unhurried. Drawing him into anticipation without pushing. Speaking as much to himself as to Sho. Tender and certain.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright immediate response. Energy restored. Not loud, but genuine excitement — the kind a six-year-old shows when something wonderful is about to happen. Forward-leaning voice.
